admin.title: Grade scales and rubrics
admin.intro: A grade scale turns a percentage into a grade. Each kind of result has one default scale, used whenever an assessment, a quiz or a rubric does not name its own. Rubrics are what observers score in a classroom observation.
admin.rubricsHelp: The default rubric is the one observers score new observations with.
admin.criterionCount: {count, plural, one {# criterion} other {# criteria}}, out of {total}

done.bandsSavedProblems: Saved, but the scale is not complete. No grade for: {gaps}. More than one grade for: {overlaps}.
done.defaultSet: This is now the default scale.
done.deactivatedDefault: Switched off. It is no longer the default, so this kind of result has no default scale until you choose one.
done.rubricDefaultSet: Observers now score new observations with this rubric.
done.rubricDeactivatedDefault: Switched off. It is no longer the default rubric, so choose another one for new observations.
done.quizScaleSet: Saved. Results of this quiz are graded with this scale.

errors.not_found: It no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.name_taken: That name is already used. Choose another.
errors.band_label: Band {row}: give it a label of up to 32 characters.
errors.band_range: Band {row} ({label}): the percentages must be whole numbers from 0 to 100, and "from" cannot be more than "to".
errors.band_duplicate: Band {row}: the label {label} is used twice.

errors.wrong_scale_kind: That scale grades something else. Choose a scale of the right kind.

errors.criterion_scored: {title} has already been scored in an observation, so it cannot be removed. You can rename it.

errors.rubric_scored: This rubric cannot be deleted: {cycles, plural, one {# observation has} other {# observations have}} been scored with it. Switch it off instead.
errors.busy: Someone else changed the default at the same moment. Reload the page and try again.

scale.bandsHelp: Each band covers whole percentages, from and to included. A score is rounded to a whole percentage first, so 90.5% counts as 91%. Every percentage from 0 to 100 should fall in exactly one band.
scale.overlaps: More than one grade for: {list} (the higher band wins)
scale.complete: Every percentage from 0 to 100 has exactly one grade.
scale.noBands: This scale has no bands yet, so it gives no grades.
scale.kindFixed: It grades {kind}. That cannot change once the scale exists.
scale.usage: Named by {assessments, plural, one {# assessment} other {# assessments}}, {quizzes, plural, one {# quiz} other {# quizzes}} and {rubrics, plural, one {# rubric} other {# rubrics}}.
scale.defaultExplain: It is the default for {kind}: whatever does not name its own scale is graded with it.
scale.makeDefaultExplain: Make it the default for {kind}. The current default stops being one.
scale.deactivateDefaultExplain: Switching it off also stops it being the default.
scale.deactivateExplain: A scale that is switched off cannot be chosen for anything new. What already names it keeps its grades.
scale.activateExplain: It is switched off. Switch it on to use it again.
scale.deleteWarning: This deletes the scale and its {count, plural, one {# band} other {# bands}}. It cannot be undone.

rubric.criteriaHelp: The observer scores each criterion from 0 to its highest score. The total, as a percentage, gets its level from the rubric's grade scale.
rubric.scoredNote: {count, plural, one {# observation has} other {# observations have}} been scored with this rubric. Renaming and reordering are safe; scored criteria cannot be removed.
rubric.defaultExplain: Observers score new observations with this rubric.
rubric.makeDefaultExplain: Make it the rubric observers score new observations with. The current default stops being one.
rubric.deactivateDefaultExplain: Switching it off also stops it being the default rubric.
rubric.deactivateExplain: A rubric that is switched off cannot be chosen for new observations. Scores already given stay.
rubric.activateExplain: It is switched off. Switch it on to use it again.
rubric.deleteWarning: This deletes the rubric and its {count, plural, one {# criterion} other {# criteria}}. It cannot be undone.

marks.title: Marks
marks.intro: Set a test for one of your classes, enter each student's marks, and see their grades. When the marks are complete, send them to the programme administrator for approval.
marks.introAll: Every teacher's assessments, newest first. You approve them from <link>Approvals</link>.
marks.notLinked: Your login is not linked to a teacher record, so you have no classes to set tests for. Ask a programme administrator to link it.
marks.noClasses: You have no classes yet. <link>Add your classes</link> first.
marks.none: You have not set any assessment yet.
marks.noneAll: No teacher has set an assessment yet.
